Subject: Thank You for an Exceptional Stay

Dear Hotel Manager,

I am writing to express my sincere gratitude for the wonderful experience I had during my recent stay at your hotel. The service provided throughout my visit was truly exceptional, and it made my trip memorable in every way.

I would like to specifically commend [Employee Name 1] and [Employee Name 2] for their outstanding hospitality. Their attentiveness, professionalism, and warm demeanor went above and beyond what I expected, ensuring that every aspect of my stay was comfortable and enjoyable.

Because of the high quality of service and the welcoming atmosphere, I will definitely be recommending your hotel to my peers and colleagues. I look forward to returning in the future.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
